• The money market has remained fairly stable.
• Yields on short-term government securities have
remained relatively unchanged during most of 2017.
• Interest rate on 91-days, 182-days and 364-days
Treasury bills was 8.6%, 10.5% and 11%, respectively
in January 2017 compared to 8.1%, 10.7% and 11.2%,
respectively at the close of 2017.
• The average interbank rate remained volatile
throughout 2017 as a result of the skewed
distribution of liquidity within the banking sector.
• Full year operating under interest rates caps that
were implemented in September 2016.
